corrections.original: Yo estoy queriendo un café con leche.

issues.rule: Polite requests often use quisiera / me gustaría, not estar + querer progressive.

corrections.explanation: For ordering, 'Quisiera…' sounds natural and polite at B1.

corrections.original: Ayer yo fui al mercado y compro fruta.
corrections.corrected: Ayer fui al mercado y compré fruta.

issues.rule: Narrative past: preterite for completed actions (compré).
Subject pronoun yo often omitted when clear.

corrections.explanation: Match preterite fui with preterite compré in the same time frame.
